title: Sharp Projection Bounds for Intermediate Dimensions of Measures
summary: We prove sharp bounds for the upper and lower intermediate dimensions of orthogonal and radial projections of compactly supported measures. Both dimension functions are preserved almost everywhere when the quasi-Assouad dimension does not exceed the target dimension. We obtain exceptional-set estimates using the entire source dimension function, with sharpness for explicit families. We also construct a fixed measure whose projected dimension functions vary on open direction sets, even when all source dimensions lie below the target dimension.
